ambiguities.source_text: Create a field for the Email Subject and a field for the Email Body
ambiguities.intent: Use the constant subject Secret Santa.

ambiguities.source_text: e.g. Tom, the results are in, your secret santee is: Ellie. Good luck finding a great gift!
ambiguities.ref: email_body = f"{santa_name} the results are in your secret santee is: {santee_name}. Good luck finding a great gift!"
ambiguities.intent: Insert the giver and alphabetical successor in the supplied template. Commas after the giver name and after in are optional; all names and other words remain required.

ambiguities.source_text: Some of the email addresses contain typos. Clean them up
ambiguities.ref: query.md: Some of the email addresses contain typos. Clean them up
ambiguities.intent: Replace comma or exclamation mark typos with periods in email domains.
